decisions.question: Should pip replace JavaScript or share it?
decisions.answer: Bundle the same JavaScript CLI and require existing Node.js 22+ without npm/npx.
decisions.source: User request: Shared Core and npm-independent distribution.

decisions.question: How to add approvals without breaking two existing stages?
decisions.answer: Keep implicit implement/review gates; explicit --workflow enables full contract approvals.
decisions.source: User request: additive schema-1 upgrade and backward compatibility.
